protocol.cases: 256 factorial cases: initial bits=(case>>7,case>>6,case>>5)&1; stable mode=(case>>4)&1; target bits x,y,z=(case>>3,case>>2,case>>1)&1; last contact reversed when case&1. Six lexicographic consistent identity permutations, and three arbitrary new string handles mapped to slots. 1536 correlated views per family/sensor policy. No random selection.
protocol.comparisons: Per family/policy/model/seed: accuracy and proper scores, all-query counts, full-to-hidden_resets correct-to-wrong/wrong-to-correct IDs, paired reversed-role correctness, unchanged-bit error counts. Inverse-map six identifier views to identity for distribution TV and tie/MAP sensitivity. For each empirical abstraction report training-key support and explicit unsupported-path counts; unsupported controls do not prove neural superiority. Report all seeds, mean and worst; no iid interval over permutations.
protocol.control_policy: Restore informative training tables without refitting. first_contact reuses the unchanged contact table but supplies only the earliest contact record to its context; this supplied static-context abstraction is declared before scores. prefix/local/contact remain unchanged. Unknown context on any positive-weight branch causes explicit abstention, never renormalization over supported paths. no_change_last_observed predicts its latest measured three bits and overwrites only subsequently observed coordinates; supplied persistence, not an inferred world fact.
protocol.custody: Same assistant author, separately implemented evaluator; NOT independent authorship, independent custody or G1 admission. New outcomes are not used to select model changes.
protocol.decision_rule: No further tuning on these outcomes. Preserve the first result even on failure. Success is a bounded transfer result, not G1 admission: independently authored/held challenge and capacity/compute-matched evidence remain outstanding. A first_contact empirical control matching the models continues to reject special neural superiority. If identifiable partial queries fail, isolate observation-filter versus learned-transition versus representation error before any extension. No language or production change.
protocol.execution: Commit implementation and synthetic invariant tests separately after this protocol before evaluation. One serial no-training evaluation on CPU PyTorch 2.10.0+cpu, float64, one intra/inter-op thread, deterministic algorithms, PYTHONHASHSEED=0. Use nonexistent output directory outside source; retain complete forecasts, masks, actions, gold, oracle distributions, checkpoint checks, source hashes and actual CPU/wall/RSS costs. 15-minute process deadline; preserve incomplete output and fail without silent retry. Ordinary CI runs invariants only. Implementation failure before any scientific forecasts may be repaired transparently; after forecasts are opened changes require a new protocol, never overwrite this attempt.

families.reordered: set(A,1), set(B,1), contact(A,B), set(C,z), set(A,x), set(B,y), contact(B,C) or contact(C,B), observe
families.reversed: set(A,1), set(B,1), contact(B,A), set(C,z), set(B,y), set(A,x), contact(C,A) or contact(A,C), observe

protocol.inference: One COMMON exact finite-path Bayesian wrapper around each unchanged model's predict/receive interface. Enumerate only possible current binary worlds, propagate learned conditional probabilities, condition on actual visible bits, retain recurrent/mode state separately for every hypothetical path. Hypothetical branch values never become observed facts. No world physics, mode label, hidden bit, future reading or evaluator annotation enters the wrapper. Missing values encoded -1 with explicit boolean mask. No pruning, smoothing or sampling; at most 64 represented paths per episode under this protocol, abort rather than truncate. This inference algorithm is SUPPLIED, not learned partial-observation competence. Full-sensor path must equal direct replay in distributions. Both families and empirical memories use identical realized actions/masks/readings; empirical memory uses hypothetical full prefixes only within the declared latent-path calculation, never as independent evidence.
protocol.physics: Same deterministic binary directed interaction as the training environment: mode 0 means first operand is source; mode 1 means second operand is source. Target becomes XOR of source and target, source/others preserved. set writes its supplied bit; observe changes nothing. Evaluator-only explicit truth tables, no old simulator or model import in fixture implementation.
protocol.purpose: Test frozen common-objective checkpoints on two new chronological families and explicit missing readings. Close the opened PR52 diagnostic; do not train, tune, recalibrate or rerun it.
protocol.scoring: Reuse existing comparison_scoring normalization/score functions where compatible. Preserve raw/normalized log probabilities, explicit -inf, underflow and corrections. Score all eight steps separately; primary final query step 6, complete-world MAP, joint NLL and Brier. Lexicographic exact-tie MAP with tie-aware diagnostics. Record coverage and wrong/correct/abstained per all queries. An infinite answered NLL makes aggregate infinite; never average only finite cases. Score identifiable and ambiguous queries separately using an evaluator-only exhaustive two-mode posterior. No ECE or calibration claim required for this limited transfer test.

selection.training: NONE; restore all selected final weights with original file and tensor hash checks; keep original parameter and training-cost metadata

sensor_policies.full: All three bits observed after every action.
sensor_policies.hidden_probe: After action 2 no bits measured; after action 3 only C; after action 4 C and that action's reset participant; after action 5 all bits. All other readings full. Both probe participants have been reset before any subsequent full reading, so the original mode evidence remains absent.
sensor_policies.hidden_resets: Full except after actions 4 and 5 (zero-based): only C is measured. At query step 6 both learners must marginalize their predicted missing states; no ground-truth fill.

protocol.size: Keep this as a compact adapter/fixture around the existing models, scoring and checkpoint artifacts, not another training harness. Report added and retained LOC honestly.

source_note: all manifest source bytes checked; code commit supplied by invoking verified workflow; hashes are integrity checks, not independent custody
